tool.search_files.title: Search Indexed Files
tool.search_files.description: Read-only file search backed by KDE Baloo indexer. Returns `[{url, path, mimetype, size, mtime}]` matching `query`. Optional filters: `dir` (limit to a directory), `mimetype` (e.g. `text/plain`), `since`/`until` (RFC3339 modification-time window), `size_min`/`size_max` (bytes). All filters are applied client-side after Baloo returns results. If Baloo is not reachable via the session D-Bus (`org.kde.baloo`) or `baloosearch` is not installed, returns an empty list with an explanatory note instead of erroring.
tool.search_content.title: Search File Contents
tool.search_content.description: Read-only full-text search backed by KDE Baloo (requires Baloo content-indexing to be enabled). Same result shape as `search_files`. Baloo query language supports `content:foo` for content-only matching and `filename:bar` for filename-only matching; this tool passes the query through to Baloo unchanged and does not impose an interpretation. Degrades to an empty list with a note when Baloo is unreachable or content indexing is disabled.
tool.search_reindex.title: Trigger Baloo Reindex (Deferred)
tool.search_reindex.description: L1 deferred in this release: this tool does NOT call `daedalus-tx`, does NOT touch `baloosearch`/`balooctl`, and does NOT modify any system state. Always returns `started=false` plus a note explaining that L1 reindex requires a y/n confirmation token (daedalus-tx/confirm_token) and is not yet integrated. Callers should NOT assume the index has been rebuilt.
